notes: rk-nsex Tier A repair wave, BL4 — the third direction of the bijection: a declared `cards-v1` entry whose extraction record does not exist. The card file is present and internally plausible (it is a real rendering, kept verbatim), so a presence-only check would pass it; what is missing is the AUTHORED record it claims to be a view of, which means nothing can say what the card should contain. Reported as `cannot be regenerated for verification` and counted in `checked` — the binary recognized the generator and attempted verification — never as a pass. This is also the fixture that pins `cards-v1` findings as STRUCTURAL: unlike every other Gate 7 finding it must not demote to WARN in exploration, because a card is the artifact agents answer from and admission is phase-independent (campaign memo section 2a). The survival-through-`applyPhase` proof lives in test/render/cards.test.ts, since the corpus harness never applies the phase matrix. `aism_behavior: n/a`.
